item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Lula pushed dual-use tech without safeguards, hid cyber or AI risk decisions from public review, weakened biosafety or cyber controls, or used a catastrophic-risk domain to concentrate power. The available evidence is mostly the opposite: transparent digital governance, explicit AI rights language, precautionary cyber policy, and technical committees for climate risk.","evidence":[{"title":"Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York","publisher":"Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"September 24, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york","summary":"Lula said AI should be “a tool for peace, not war,” and that it should respect human rights, protect personal data, and promote information integrity. This is direct precaution/transparency evidence in a high-risk tech domain.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Estratégia Nacional de Governo Digital","publisher":"Governo Digital / Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos","date":"2024 framework page citing Decree No. 12.069 of June 21, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/governodigital/pt-br/estrategias-e-governanca-digital/estrategianacional/","summary":"The strategy says the 2024-2027 digital state should use technology appropriately, reuse data securely, expand transparency, and strengthen privacy/security. That is strong evidence of precaution and disclosure in a dual-use-adjacent domain.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7","1B.3"]},{"title":"Políticas Públicas","publisher":"Anatel","date":"April 26, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/anatel/pt-br/assuntos/seguranca-cibernetica/politicas-publicas","summary":"The page describes Brazil’s national cyber policy as based on sovereignty, fundamental rights, incident prevention, resilience, education, and multistakeholder cooperation; it also notes the CNCiber was already operational in 2024. Climate is not cyber or bio, but it is an “other catastrophic-risk domain,” and the policy choice is precautionary and institutional.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"Lei nº 11.105 de 24/03/2005","publisher":"Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços","date":"Updated January 25, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/mdic/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/institucional/atos-normativos/leis/lei-no-11-105-de-24-de-marco-de-2005","summary":"The official text highlights safety norms, inspection mechanisms, and the principle of precaution for GMO-related activities. This is background, not a Lula-initiated 2024 reform, but it is still relevant to how Brazil handled biological dual-use-adjacent governance.","question_ids":["1B.9"]}]}
